jobs.title: Flexible Part-Time Security Officer – Earn More Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Dallas, TX is seeking a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Post. This role offers fixed shifts with the flexibility to pick up extra shifts through our scheduling platform.

The position pays $18.50 per hour and requires at least 2 years of security experience, Spanish fluency, a high school diploma, and the ability to pass background and drug screens. This role fits those seeking part-time work with income stability and growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Part-Time Security Dispatcher — Tech Campus (Flexible Shifts)
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Part-Time Security Officer – Alarm Dispatch in Dallas, TX. This role involves coordinating calls, monitoring security systems, and maintaining dispatch logs to support rapid responses and safe operations at a technology and data infrastructure site.

Ideal candidates have at least 2 years of security experience, a high school diploma or GED, and be 21 or older. The position offers part-time hours with evening and night shifts and the potential for career growth

jobs.title: Front Desk Security Officer — Part-Time, Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer – Front Desk Enhanced Part Time in Dallas, TX. This role offers flexible, reliable hours at an assigned site with the option to pick up additional shifts through our scheduling platform, providing income stability and hands-on experience in the security industry.

The position pays $21.50 per hour with a fixed schedule and opportunities to grow into a full-time schedule; prior access control and customer service experience is preferred.
